name: Skyclave key
description: The glowing key Nahiri uses to light a path and open the wall of the Core's chamber.

pages_say.description: A glowing tile from the Skyclave's heart that holds some of the core's power and unlocks it.
The glowing key Nahiri obtained from the Akoum Skyclave.
